title: CleanDataService - Tooling API
description: Represents a data service that adds and updates data in existing records in an org.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: User-friendly text that describes the data service.

DeveloperName.description: A unique name for this data service. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. Provides a globally unique identifier for the data service, which prevents conflicts with other data services that have the same MasterLabel. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: The language of the data service. The following values are supported: Chinese (Simplified): zh_CN Chinese (Traditional): zh_TW Danish: da Dutch: nl_NL English: en_US Finnish: fi French: fr German: de Italian: it Japanese: ja Korean: ko Norwegian: no Portuguese (Brazil): pt_BR Russian: ru Spanish: es Spanish (Mexico): es_MX Spanish (Mexico) defaults to Spanish for customer-defined translations. Swedish: sv Thai: th The Salesforce user interface is fully translated to Thai, but Help is in English.

ManageableState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ManageableState.description: Indicates the manageable state of the specified component that is contained in a package: beta deleted deprecated deprecatedEditable installed installedEditable released unmanaged

MasterLabel.description: Master label for this object. This display value is the internal label that is not translated.

MatchEngine.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MatchEngine.description: A key that maps to the internal data service identifier.

NamespacePrefix.description: The namespace prefix associated with the data service, which is assigned to the Lightning Platform AppExchange package. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. The namespace helps differentiate custom objects and fields from those in use by other data services.
